notes.title: The new version of "I Am Butter" is coming!!!
notes.notes:
Hello, friends who love butter! The new version of I Am Butter is updated!

We have optimized it for the problems that appeared in the previous beta version!

1. Teaching level optimization

2. The controller ray is optimized, and the controller of different devices has been adapted

3. Angle of view optimization, second stage scene optimization

4. Player guidance optimization, adding animation guidance and text voice guidance

If you have any comments or suggestions,


—— Sincerely, Patha Pradipa

notes.title: I am butter recent game version
notes.notes:
Hi there!

I Am Butter VR is early access version , which has been loved by many users since its launch. First of all, thank you for playing our game.

But in this EA version, we also found a lot of problems, including the English translation is not comprehensive enough, the error of the perspective and the actual situation when jumping, and some game difficulty problems.

We are sorry to those bad experience. We will have a game update in the near future, which will improve the above problems. Thank you again for playing our game.

Thanks
